programme.title: Altered
programme.desc: Fifteen years after they were abducted by aliens, four men get a chance to take revenge when they capture one of the creatures.","large":"Forever damaged by their stint as the scientific subjects of hostile alien creatures, a trio of alien-abduction survivors -- Otis (Michael C. Williams), Duke (Brad William Henke) and Cody (Paul McCarthy-Boyington) -- troll the wooded site of their disappearance, heavily armed, in search of their attackers. After wounding a violent alien in the woods, the three drag its dying body to the home of reclusive fellow abductee Wyatt (Adam Kaufman), barricade themselves in and prepare for the worst.

programme.title: Werewolf: The Beast Among Us
programme.desc: A mysterious creature terrorizes a village, and Daniel teams up with werewolf hunters to track down the vicious beast. As villagers are attacked one by one and, themselves, turned into beasts, Daniel fears the foe is someone close to them all.

programme.title: Hulk
programme.desc: Bruce Banner, a genetics researcher with a tragic past, suffers an accident that causes him to transform into a raging green monster when he gets angry.","large":"Eric Bana ("Black Hawk Down") stars as scientist Bruce Banner, whose inner demons transform him in the aftermath of a catastrophic experiment; Jennifer Connelly portrays Betty Ross, whose scientific genius unwittingly helps unleash the Hulk; Nick Nolte plays Banner's brilliant father, who passes on a tragic legacy to his son; and Sam Elliott portrays the commander of a top-secret military research center.

programme.title: Bustin' Loose
programme.desc: An ex-convict (Richard Pryor) takes handicapped orphans and their teacher (Cicely Tyson) from Philadelphia to Washington state by bus.","large":"Parole officer Donald (Robert Christian) compels his foul-mouthed ex-con charge Joe Braxton (Richard Pryor) to escort a bus full of special education students from Philadelphia to the Pacific Northwest, where their teacher Vivian Perry (Cicely Tyson) plans to set up a new school. But when Braxton's latest attempt at going straight becomes a frustrating series of mishaps, he struggles to complete the job he was hired to do while resisting his growing affection for Vivian and the children.

programme.title: Born in East L.A.
programme.desc: A Los Angeles native (Cheech Marin) is rounded up by mistake with illegal aliens and dumped south of the border.

programme.title: Slap Shot
programme.desc: A minor-league hockey team makes sports history when its members decide to spruce up the team's image by playing dirty.","large":"In the small New England town of Charlestown, the local mill is about to lay off 10,000 workers. The town's minor league hockey team, the Charlestown Chiefs, is doing no better. After years of failure, this will be the team's last season. Exasperated player and coach Reggie Dunlop (Paul Newman) lets the club's recent acquisitions, the Hanson Brothers, play. The brothers' actively violent and thuggish style of play excites the fans. Dunlop retools the team, using violence to draw big crowds.

programme.title: For Love of the Game
programme.desc: An aging pitcher (Kevin Costner) learns that he will soon lose his girlfriend (Kelly Preston) and his spot with the Detroit Tigers.","large":"Forty-year-old pitcher Billy Chapel (Kevin Costner) is practically a dinosaur by professional baseball standards, fast approaching the end of his career. But, as Chapel stands on the mound pitching the game of his life, his thoughts don't turn to his prized history in sports, but rather return again and again to his tumultuous relationship with Jane Aubrey (Kelly Preston), a single mom who has stood at his side through the good and the bad but is now on the verge of leaving him.

programme.title: The Babe
programme.desc: Abandoned as a boy, George Herman Ruth (John Goodman) grows up to be a larger-than-life baseball hero.","large":"George Herman "Babe" Ruth (John Goodman) grows from a troubled boy who was sent to an orphanage to one of the most successful baseball players on record. Babe first becomes a power hitter and pitcher for the Boston Red Sox. After a falling-out with Red Sox owner Harry Frazee (Peter Donat), Babe is sold to the New York Yankees. He is idolized in New York, setting a record for home runs, as well as creating dramatic moments like hitting two homers for a sick boy in the hospital.

programme.title: The Best of Times
programme.desc: Two men (Robin Williams, Kurt Russell) get to replay a high-school football game 16 years after one dropped the other's touchdown pass.","large":"Married banker Jack Dundee (Robin Williams) has lived his life regretting a botched play he made in a high school football game. His friend Reno Hightower (Kurt Russell), who threw the pass that Jack dropped, is deeply in debt from operating his car garage. With Reno, Jack hatches a plan to reunite all the players from the old game and replay it, hoping that this time he can make amends. When the game eventually happens, Jack again finds himself at the center of a key play.

programme.title: Bustin' Loose
programme.desc: An ex-convict (Richard Pryor) takes handicapped orphans and their teacher (Cicely Tyson) from Philadelphia to Washington state by bus.","large":"Parole officer Donald (Robert Christian) compels his foul-mouthed ex-con charge Joe Braxton (Richard Pryor) to escort a bus full of special education students from Philadelphia to the Pacific Northwest, where their teacher Vivian Perry (Cicely Tyson) plans to set up a new school. programme.title: Prince of Darkness
programme.desc: A priest (Donald Pleasence) summons a professor (Victor Wong) to an old church to see a canister of liquid Satan.","large":"Poking around in a church cellar, a priest (Donald Pleasence) finds an otherworldly vial filled with slime. Frightened, he brings his discovery to a circle of top scholars and scientists, who eventually learn that the strange liquid is the essence of Satan. The slime then begins to seep out, turning some of the academics into zombified killers. As the possessed battle the survivors, student Kelly (Susan Blanchard) is infected by a large quantity of the liquid and becomes Satan personified.

programme.title: Army of Darkness
programme.desc: Because of a time warp, a supermarket worker finds himself fighting in medieval England with a chainsaw and a '73 Oldsmobile.

programme.title: Land of the Dead
programme.desc: A mercenary leader (Simon Baker) squares off with a rebellious comrade (John Leguizamo), while flesh-eating zombies threaten their fortified city.","large":"In a world where zombies form the majority of the population, the remaining humans build a feudal society away from the undead. Ruthless Paul Kaufman (Dennis Hopper) rules and protects this microcosm but enforces painful class distinctions. Second-in-command Cholo DeMora (John Leguizamo) attempts to lead a secret rebellion against Kaufman's tyranny, but when the zombies begin to evolve, the survivors must discover a way to protect themselves from a zombie horde that can learn and adapt.

programme.title: Darkman II: The Return of Durant
programme.desc: Crime lord Robert G. Durant (Larry Drake) awakens from a coma and again destroys disfigured Darkman's (Arnold Vosloo) liquid-skin laboratory.","large":"Scientist Peyton Westlake (Arnold Vosloo) returns to his lab believing he has disposed of his nemesis, mobster Robert G. Durant (Larry Drake), who gave him the hideous burns that transformed him into his alter ego, Darkman. While Darkman is perfecting an artificial skin that will restore his old appearance, Durant inexplicably returns to torment him. Overcome by rage, Darkman disguises himself with the artificial skin, setting out to infiltrate Durant's world and bring him to justice.

programme.title: Frenzy
programme.desc: Circumstantial evidence holds an innocent Londoner (Jon Finch) for the work of a rapist who strangles his victims with neckties.","large":"London is held in the grip of a serial killer whose modus operandi is to murder his victims by strangling them with a necktie. When short-tempered ex-Royal Air Force officer Richard Blaney (Jon Finch) discovers his ex-wife (Barbara Leigh-Hunt) murdered, Blaney becomes a suspect. Forced to go on the run, Blaney attempts to take refuge with his best friend, fruit merchant Bob Rusk (Barry Foster) ; however, Rusk may, in fact, be the necktie murderer himself.

programme.title: Bustin' Loose
programme.desc: An ex-convict (Richard Pryor) takes handicapped orphans and their teacher (Cicely Tyson) from Philadelphia to Washington state by bus.","large":"Parole officer Donald (Robert Christian) compels his foul-mouthed ex-con charge Joe Braxton (Richard Pryor) to escort a bus full of special education students from Philadelphia to the Pacific Northwest, where their teacher Vivian Perry (Cicely Tyson) plans to set up a new school. But when Braxton's latest attempt at going straight becomes a frustrating series of mishaps, he struggles to complete the job he was hired to do while resisting his growing affection for Vivian and the children.

programme.title: Born in East L.A.
programme.desc: A Los Angeles native (Cheech Marin) is rounded up by mistake with illegal aliens and dumped south of the border.

programme.title: Serial Mom
programme.desc: A seemingly perfect wife and mother (Kathleen Turner) from Baltimore gains celebrity status as a serial killer.

programme.title: Stop! Or My Mom Will Shoot
programme.desc: A Los Angeles policeman (Sylvester Stallone) has his little mother (Estelle Getty) from New Jersey for a partner, whether he likes it or not.","large":"Smarting from a romantic breakup, macho police Sgt. Joe Bomowski (Sylvester Stallone) gets a cross-country visit from his mother, Tutti (Estelle Getty). Her misguided efforts to help only fray his nerves, but that doesn't stop her from nagging Joe to be more open about his feelings toward his ex-girlfriend and current boss, Lt. Gwen Harper (JoBeth Williams). When Tutti witnesses a brutal multiple murder, she takes her meddling to the extreme by tagging along to help her son solve the case.

programme.title: Streets of Fire
programme.desc: A rock star's (Diane Lane) ex-lover (Michael Paré) leads a rescue after urban bikers kidnap her from the stage.","large":"Raven Shaddock (Willem Dafoe), along with his gang of merciless biker friends, kidnaps rock singer Ellen Aim (Diane Lane). Ellen's former lover, soldier-for-hire Tom Cody (Michael Paré), happens to be passing through town on a visit. In an attempt to save his star act, Ellen's manager, Billy Fish (Rick Moranis), hires Tom to rescue Ellen. Billy and Tom, along with former soldier McCoy (Amy Madigan), battle through dangerous cityscapes, determined to get Ellen back.

programme.title: Sneakers
programme.desc: An ex-'60s-radical computer hacker (Robert Redford) and his company are tapped for a shady black-box job.","large":"Computer hacker Martin (Robert Redford) heads a group of specialists who test the security of various San Francisco companies. Martin is approached by two National Security Agency officers who ask him to steal a newly invented decoder. Martin and his team discover that the black box can crack any encryption code, posing a huge threat if it lands in the wrong hands. When Martin realizes the NSA men who approached him are rogue agents, they frame him for the murder of the device's inventor.

programme.title: The Car
programme.desc: A Western deputy sheriff (James Brolin) chases a driverless black car that keeps running people down.","large":"Two bicyclists are run down by a strange black car in the desert near a small town in Utah. But this is just the first in a series of hit-and-run murders. Sheriff Wade Parent is called in to investigate, and his deputy, Everett, is killed by the black sedan, which, some witnesses say, has no one behind its wheel. When the car threatens a local school parade, the lives of the town's children and Wade's teacher girlfriend, Lauren, are endangered.

programme.title: Black Dog
programme.desc: A trucker with a vehicular manslaughter conviction agrees to drive a suspicious shipment for his boss.","large":"An ex-con takes a job truck driving across the country. However, the truck is filled with illegal weapons, and now he must fight to save his family. The stakes are high as gun runners, government agents and a fleet of monstrous 18-wheelers pursue him in an intense highway duel.

programme.title: The Jackal
programme.desc: A jailed IRA operative (Richard Gere) helps the FBI track a masterful assassin (Bruce Willis) about to perform a political killing.","large":"During an FBI raid on a Moscow nightclub, the brother of Russian gangster Terek Murad (David Hayman) is killed. Murad wants revenge and hires anonymous hit man the Jackal (Bruce Willis) to kill FBI Deputy Director Carter Preston (Sidney Poitier). With the help of Russian agent Valentina Koslova (Diane Venora), Preston finds the only man who knows what the notorious Jackal looks like, imprisoned IRA terrorist Declan Mulqueen (Richard Gere), and forces him to help hunt down the hit man.

programme.title: Mercury Rising
programme.desc: An FBI renegade (Bruce Willis) tries to stop his nemesis (Alec Baldwin) from killing an autistic boy (Miko Hughes) who cracked a government code.","large":""Mercury Rising" stars Bruce Willis as Art Jeffries, a renegade FBI agent who combats ruthless federal agents to protect Simon (Miko Hughes), a 9-year-old autistic boy who has cracked the government's new unbreakable code. He can read MERCURY, the most advanced encryption code yet created, as easily as other kids read English. This ability renders the new billion-dollar secret code vulnerable, especially if enemies of the United States should learn of Simon's abilities and capture him.

programme.title: End of Days
programme.desc: An ex-cop (Arnold Schwarzenegger) must protect a woman chosen by Satan (Gabriel Byrne) to be the mother of the Antichrist.","large":"With the millennium approaching, a series of disturbing signs suggests that Satan (Arnold Schwarzenegger) has returned to Earth and is walking the streets of New York City. It seems that Satan needs to find a woman who will bear his child, as the time for the arrival of the anti-Christ draws near.

programme.title: The Darkness
programme.desc: A supernatural force terrorizes a couple (Kevin Bacon, Radha Mitchell) and their two children after the young son brings home some mysterious rocks from the Grand Canyon.","large":"Peter Taylor (Kevin Bacon), his wife Bronny and their two children return to Los Angeles after a fun-filled vacation to the Grand Canyon. Strange events soon start to plague the family, including young son Michael's increasingly erratic behavior. The Taylors learn that Michael brought back some mysterious rocks that he discovered inside a cave. Unfortunately, something followed them home as the clan now find themselves in a battle with a supernatural force that preys on their worst fears.

programme.title: The Scorpion King 4: Quest for Power
programme.desc: Mathayus is framed for the murder of the king of Norvania, and he and his allies have to stop the evil heir from finding a mythical power.

programme.title: The Scorpion King: Book of Souls
programme.desc: Two fierce warriors search for the powerful Book of Souls to fight an evil warlord.

programme.title: Serial Mom
programme.desc: A seemingly perfect wife and mother (Kathleen Turner) from Baltimore gains celebrity status as a serial killer.

programme.title: Children of Men
programme.desc: When infertility threatens mankind with extinction, a disillusioned bureaucrat becomes the unlikely champion in the fight for the survival of Earth's population.","large":"When infertility threatens mankind with extinction and the last child born has perished, a disillusioned bureaucrat (Clive Owen) becomes the unlikely champion in the fight for the survival of Earth's population; He must face down his own demons and protect the planet's last remaining hope from danger.

programme.title: White Noise
programme.desc: An architect (Michael Keaton) believes his dead wife (Chandra West) is using electronic devices to communicate with him.","large":"Architect Jonathan Rivers (Michael Keaton) is happily married to author Anna (Chandra West), but tragedy strikes when she is killed in an accident. Deep in grief, Jonathan hears from Raymond Price (Ian McNeice), who claims that he has intercepted messages from Anna via electronic voice phenomena. Jonathan eventually comes to believe Raymond's claims, but, as he is drawn further into investigating the phenomenon, a sinister supernatural presence invades his life.

programme.title: White Noise 2: The Light
programme.desc: After nearly being killed along with his family, a man recovers and realizes that he can sense when someone is about to die.","large":"A man's family is killed, but he survives -- barely. After recovering, he realizes that he has changed in some way: He now senses when someone is about to die. In his attempts to save people who are near death, he discovers there is a price to pay for interfering with the cosmos.

programme.title: The New Daughter
programme.desc: A single father (Kevin Costner) is puzzled by his daughter's (Ivana Baquero) weird behavior, which begins soon after he moves his family to a secluded woodland home.

programme.title: Mama
programme.desc: As a woman (Jessica Chastain) tries to reintroduce her lover's (Nikolaj Coster-Waldau) traumatized nieces to a normal life, disturbing questions and occurrences suggest that a supernatural presence has followed the girls to her home.","large":"On the day that their parents die, sisters Lilly and Victoria vanish in the woods, prompting a frantic search by their Uncle Lucas (Nikolaj Coster-Waldau) and his girlfriend, Annabel (Jessica Chastain). Five years later, miraculously, the girls are found alive in a decaying cabin, and Lucas and Annabel welcome them into their home. But as Annabel tries to reintroduce the children to a normal life, she finds that someone -- or something -- still wants to tuck them in at night.

programme.title: The Unborn
programme.desc: With the help of a spiritualist (Gary Oldman), a woman (Odette Yustman) uncovers a family curse dating back to Nazi Germany and involving a demonic spirit with the power to inhabit anything or anyone.","large":"Plagued by nightmares and visitations from tortured ghosts, Casey Beldon turns to a spiritual adviser named Sendak for help. They discover a family curse that dates back to Nazi Germany: an evil spirit that can take over the body of anyone and is getting stronger with each possession, as it tries to gain full entrance to this world.

programme.title: The Forest
programme.desc: While investigating the disappearance of her twin sister, a young American encounters the tormented spirits of Japan's mysterious and legendary Aokigahara Forest.","large":"When her twin sister disappears in Japan, a young American named Sara becomes determined to find out what happened to her. Sara's investigation leads her to the legendary Aokigahara Forest, located at the base of Mount Fuji. Accompanied by expatriate Aiden, she enters the mysterious wilderness after being warned to "stay on the path." Her investigation plunges her into a dark world where the angry and tormented souls of the dead prey on those who dare to explore the forest.

programme.title: Dead Silence
programme.desc: After his wife meets a grisly end, a man (Ryan Kwanten) returns to their haunted hometown and uncovers a supernatural link to her death.","large":"After his wife meets a grisly end, Jamie Ashen (Ryan Kwanten) returns to their creepy hometown of Ravens Fair to unravel the mystery of her murder. Once there, he discovers the legend of Mary Shaw (Joan Heney), a murdered ventriloquist whose eerie presence still looms over the town. As he desperately digs for answers, Jamie encounters the curse that took his wife's life and threatens his own.

programme.desc: A man inherits a haunted house after spending time in a mental institution.

programme.title: The Forest
programme.desc: While investigating the disappearance of her twin sister, a young American encounters the tormented spirits of Japan's mysterious and legendary Aokigahara Forest.","large":"When her twin sister disappears in Japan, a young American named Sara becomes determined to find out what happened to her. Sara's investigation leads her to the legendary Aokigahara Forest, located at the base of Mount Fuji. Accompanied by expatriate Aiden, she enters the mysterious wilderness after being warned to "stay on the path." Her investigation plunges her into a dark world where the angry and tormented souls of the dead prey on those who dare to explore the forest.

programme.title: Games
programme.desc: A mysterious woman (Simone Signoret) in black moves in with married Manhattan thrill-seekers (James Caan, Katharine Ross) and helps one trick the other.","large":"Wealthy and bored, Paul (James Caan) and Jennifer Montgomery (Katharine Ross) while away their hours in a New York City apartment filled with pinball machines and other amusements. The couple's routine is upended when door-to-door saleswoman Lisa Schindler (Simone Signoret) drops by and is suddenly taken ill. The Montgomerys let her spend the night. And soon, the sophisticated Lisa and her hosts embark on a new set of very adult -- and very dangerous -- games.

programme.desc: Herman appoints himself Eddie's coach.

programme.desc: Lily and Herman take part-time jobs to buy each other anniversary presents.

programme.desc: Herman is forced to practice what he preaches when he urges Eddie to ignore a schoolyard bully.

programme.title: The Munsters

programme.title: Gone
programme.desc: A televangelist (Gregory Itzin) influences a confrontational man (Billy Burke) motivated by revenge.

programme.title: The Green Inferno
programme.desc: Student activists (Lorenza Izzo, Ariel Levy) crash-land in the Amazon and encounter an indigenous tribe of cannibals who'd like to have them for dinner.","large":"New York college student Justine (Lorenza Izzo), a lawyer's daughter, meets a student activist named Alejandro (Ariel Levy) when he goes on a hunger strike on behalf of underpaid janitors. Smitten, Justine agrees to help Alejandro undertake his next project: to save the Amazon. She soon learns to regret her decision when their plane crashes in the Peruvian jungle and she and the rest of their group are taken captive by a tribe of hungry cannibals.

programme.title: The Guardian
programme.desc: Yuppies (Dwier Brown, Carey Lowell) with a baby hire a nanny (Jenny Seagrove), a druid witch who sacrifices babies to a tree.","large":"Optimistic about their future, well-off parents Kate (Carey Lowell) and Phil (Dwier Brown) hire the pleasant and lovely young Camilla (Jenny Seagrove) to live with them and care for their new baby. Though Camilla seems like an answer to their prayers, she proves to be more than she appears, and a diabolical plot involving the wellbeing of their child is uncovered. The young parents are forced to fight supernatural forces for the life of their vulnerable offspring.

programme.title: The Hitcher II: I've Been Waiting
programme.desc: A psychopathic hitchhiker (Jake Busey) terrorizes a man (C. Thomas Howell) and his girlfriend (Kari Wuhrer) as they take a road trip.","large":"Years after being traumatized by a hitchhiker, Jim Halsey (C. Thomas Howell) is trying to piece his life back together. After being suspended from the police force, he decides to return to Texas to speak with a friend about his problems. He reluctantly agrees to let his girlfriend, Maggie (Kari Wuhrer), join him. As they drive, Maggie lets a stranded driver (Jake Busey) into the car. Halsey becomes suspicious and kicks him out, but the stranger returns, undeterred, to wreak havoc.

programme.title: I Saw What You Did
programme.desc: Two teenage girls, bored while baby-sitting, make prank phone calls, completely unaware one of the people on the other end of the line has just killed his wife and now thinks the girls must be silenced.","large":"Kit (Sarah Lane) and her best friend, Libby (Andi Garrett), are two teenage girls bored while baby-sitting. To pass the time, they make prank phone calls, telling the person on the other end of the line, "I saw what you did, and I know who you are!" It's all in good fun, until they call a man (John Ireland) who just murdered his wife and buried her in the woods. Convinced they actually do know his secret, he becomes determined to find out who they are and silence them forever.

programme.title: Incarnate
programme.desc: Recruited by a Vatican emissary (Catalina Sandino Moreno), an exorcist (Aaron Eckhart) taps into the subconscious mind of a tormented boy (David Mazouz) to free him from demonic possession.","large":"After a single mother witnesses terrifying symptoms of demonic possession in her 11-year-old son (David Mazouz), a Vatican representative calls on wheelchair-bound scientist Dr. Seth Ember (Aaron Eckhart) to rid him of the evil spirit. Driven by a personal agenda rooted in his own tragic past, Ember enters the boy's unconscious mind where he confronts a demon as ferocious as it is ingenious.

programme.title: Karma
programme.desc: When recent college grad Manny has trouble making ends meet, his father-in-law offers him a job evicting delinquent tenants. Manny soon finds himself unleashing a karma demon which stalks him at every turn.

programme.title: Long Time Dead
programme.desc: A genie terrorizes London students (Lara Belmont, Melanie Gutteridge) after they unwittingly summon it with a Ouija.","large":"After a long night of dancing and drinking their way into a haze, roommates Rob (Joe Absolom), Liam (Alec Newman), Stella (Lara Belmont) and Spencer (James Hillier) and a few of their friends duck into a back room of the nightclub to play around with a Ouija board. None of the friends like what the board tells them: they will all die that night. Sure enough, one by one the young friends are slaughtered by a malevolent killer, amid revelations about satanic worship and sacrifice.

programme.title: Saint Ange
programme.desc: Strange events haunt a pregnant woman (Virginie Ledoyen) and others at a recently vacated orphanage in the French Alps.","large":"Anna is a cleaning woman who accepts a post at the St. Ange Orphanage. Then the bizarre sights and sounds begin, which seem to elude detection by the only other servant or the gloomy institution's director. Is this all in Anna's mind? Or does something more sinister lurk in the heart of St. Ange?

programme.title: Session 9
programme.desc: Asbestos removal crews start work in an abandoned insane asylum, and strange happenings begin to occur.","large":"A tale of terror when a group of asbestos removal workers start work in an abandoned insane asylum. programme.title: Love in the Forecast
programme.desc: Mientras toma un descanso de las citas para concentrarse en su carrera como aspirante a meteoróloga, Leah se hace amiga de su vecino Mark, quien le enseña la importancia de confiar en la naturaleza y en los demás.

programme.title: High Strung: Free Dance
programme.desc: Un joven coreógrafo selecciona a una bailarina contemporánea y a un pianista innovador para el nuevo espectáculo de Broadway más esperado de Nueva York. Sin embargo, el pianista y el coreógrafo se enamoran de la bailarina.

programme.title: Martha Marcy May Marlene
programme.desc: Cuando los sueños se confunden con los recuerdos, la paranoia está muy cerca. Al escapar de una secta, Martha busca refugio en su hermana, pero cuando intenta recuperar su vida, la realidad se vuelve un enigma.

programme.title: Rebeldes con causa
programme.desc: Un grupo de amigos decide romper su rutina de vida suburbana con un viaje en motocicleta, tomando un largo y soñado descanso de sus estresantes trabajos y responsabilidades familiares.

programme.title: Algo azul
programme.desc: Mejores amigos desde siempre, tienen sexo la noche antes de una boda y arruinan el vestido de la novia. En su aventura para reemplazarlo, descubren que quizás son más que amigos.

programme.title: La boda de Rosa
programme.desc: A punto de cumplir 45, Rosa se da cuenta de que ha vivido siempre para los demás y decide marcharse, dejarlo todo y apretar el botón nuclear. Quiere tomar las riendas de su vida y cumplir el sueño de tener un negocio propio.

programme.title: Amor sin barreras
programme.desc: Mientras dos bandas de jóvenes de diferentes etnias se disputan la ciudad por medio de una pelea, dos jóvenes de ambos grupos se enamoran. Pero, ¿qué es una pandilla sin su territorio? y ¿qué hay de esperanza sin amor?.

programme.title: Corazón valiente
programme.desc: William Wallace, un rebelde escocés lleno de vigor, vuelve a su tierra después de muchos años y forma un ejército al cual conduce contra el ejército inglés para la liberación de su pueblo, sometido por el rey Eduardo I de Inglaterra.

programme.title: El último rey de Escocia
programme.desc: Nicholas se dirige a Uganda para cumplir una misión. Ahí conoce a Idi, quien fue nombrado Presidente. Impresionado por la actitud de Garrigan ante momentos de crisis, Amin lo contrata como su médico personal y su confidente...

programme.title: Los ojos de Tammy Faye
programme.desc: Una mirada íntima al extraordinario ascenso, caída y redención de la televangelista Tammy Faye Bakker. En 1970 y 180, ella y su marido ascendieron por su mensaje de amor, aceptación y prosperidad.

programme.title: Abraham Lincoln: cazador de vampiros
programme.desc: La madre de Abe fue asesinada por un vampiro. Desde ese momento y con tan sólo nueve años, decide vengarse de ellos, dedicando su vida a eliminar a esos siniestros seres. Incluso siendo el presidente de su país.

programme.sub-title: Más allá del punto de ruptura

programme.title: Operación Alaska

programme.title: Alaska: hombres primitivos
programme.desc: El suministro de agua se detiene por un congelamiento, generandole dificultades al rancho. Y con una carga crítica de madera entregada en la base de la montaña, la manada debe resolver el problema para volver a poner su casa en marcha.

programme.title: Alaska: hombres primitivos

programme.title: Pasiones peligrosas
programme.desc: A Mirinda y Sam Boob los une una pasión desenfrenada, pero una serie de mentiras y traiciones empañan su felicidad. Tony Hayes podrá ser un policía modelo, pero también es mujeriego, y Monique Johnson es solo una de sus conquistas.

programme.title: El socio
programme.desc: Una empresa de bordado y serigrafía de Queens, Nueva York, está a punto de cerrar sus puertas para siempre después de que su propietario asumiera más de lo que podía abarcar.

programme.title: Campeonato de reposteros: Halloween
programme.desc: John Henson forma equipos de investigación con los pasteleros y preparan postres rellenos con muestras de laboratorio. Con la eliminación acercándose, les sirven a los jueces una loca colección de postres.

programme.title: Iron Chef America
programme.desc: La Chef Emma Hearst es la retadora más joven en entrar en el Kitchen Stadium. Ella desafía al viejo chef profesional Michael Symon. Ahora todos se preguntan si truinfará la exuberancia o la experiencia.

programme.sub-title: Amas de casa desesperadas de Texas

programme.title: Crímenes de las chicas pesadas

programme.title: Limpiadores compulsivos

programme.title: Campeonato de reposteros: Halloween
programme.desc: John Henson reta a los nueve pasteleros a crear postres con animales disecados reanimados. Los seis pasteleros con peor puntuación deberán crear postres inspirados en insectos poseídos.

programme.title: Guerras de Halloween

programme.title: Pesadilla en la cocina
programme.desc: Gordon se dirige hacia el Four Star Dines, un restaurante americano clásico, el cual tiene la cualidad de tener un dueño cuyo comportamiento, auyenta tanto al personal como a los comenzales.

programme.title: Pesadilla en la cocina
programme.desc: El chef Ramsay se enfrenta a Borelli's Pizzeria en Chicago con el objetivo de revitalizar el negocio familiar en apuros, renovando el menú y la imagen del local, en medio de tensiones familiares y prácticas obsoletas, para evitar su cierre.

programme.title: Pesadilla en la cocina
programme.desc: Gordon intenta renovar el restaurante de mariscos Voleo's, un restaurante familiar de segunda generación.

programme.title: Zuk, la brujita
programme.desc: Zouk hizo un pastel para Jojo, pero no puede comerlo porque tiene un terrible dolor de muelas. Entonces, Zouk decide curarlo con sus dedos mágicos, pero empeora las cosas al convertir los dientes de Jojo en grandes colmillos podridos.

programme.title: Zuk, la brujita
programme.desc: Zuk invitó a su amiga Galathea a una pijamada en la mansión, y para que la noche transcurra sin problemas y su tímida amiga no se asuste, decide hacer todo lo posible para que la mansión embrujada parezca de lo más normal.

programme.title: Zuk, la brujita
programme.desc: Salbrina tiene que elegir entre el concierto de Zouk y la ceremonia de energización de la varita. Entonces, Zouk propone clonarla con el "Ojo de la Duplicación". La idea funciona, pero todos descubren que pierden la mitad de la magia.

programme.desc: Como es su cumpleaños, Mandy Ratona va a un parque temático de queso con Peppa y sus amigos. / Peppa y su familia pasan el día en el mar y construyen un enorme castillo de arena.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Peppa y sus amigos están con sus abuelos en la clase de arte de la Abuela Oveja. Aunque a los abuelos les cuesta un poco seguir el ritmo, los niños los ayudan a crear obras que reflejan sus cosas favoritas.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Después de revisar el correo, Peppa encuentra un folleto sobre las clases de flamenco de Señora Gacela. Como quiere aprender qué es el flamenco, asiste a una lección. Aunque le resulta muy difícil, ¡el Señor Carnero aplaude su entusiasmo!

programme.title: Topo Gigio
programme.desc: Papá necesita un set de hielo para su sesión de fotos, pero no encuentra nada inspirador. Gigio y Zoe quieren ayudarlo. Con el 'hielo-bum' de Bob, la máquina que congela cosas, improvisan una pista de hockey en la calle.

programme.title: Héroes y hermanos
programme.desc: Mo y Lenny finalmente van a ver la película que estaban esperando. Pero cuando llegan a la taquilla para comprar sus boletos, son rechazados porque son demasiado jóvenes y solo pueden entrar con un adulto.

programme.title: Héroes y hermanos
programme.desc: Sam es elegida para competir en una importante prueba de conocimientos generales. Pero alguien le roba el matamoscas a John Cedric mientras está repasando en la biblioteca.

programme.title: Héroes y hermanos
programme.desc: Sam ha pedido el poder de controlar el clima para poder disfrutar plenamente del tiempo con su padre viendo el cometa Barney 6 pasar sobre la tierra. Pero con la potencia media, el clima cambia rápidamente y está vinculado a sus emociones.

programme.title: Héroes y hermanos
programme.desc: El señor Brick quiere un voluntario para un 'experimento de siesta' en la escuela, un protocolo que espera pueda mejorar las capacidades de aprendizaje de sus alumnos. Mo se ofrece como voluntario a la vez... junto con muchos otros niños.

programme.desc: La batalla por McCarthy continúa: un grupo de expertos intenta encontrar la única entrada conocida de la veta principal de la mina. Los habitantes del pueblo busca liberarse del dominio de Neil fabricando sus propias municiones.

programme.title: Sobrevivientes del hielo
programme.desc: El invierno no deja descansar a los habitantes del Ártico. Kyle y Peyton usan métodos nativos para curar la carne. Molly fabrica una bomba de agua para no tener que cavar en el hielo.

programme.title: Sangre apalache
programme.desc: Spencer y Eugene deben construir una vitrina para el local de Cheyenne. Pero para conseguir la madera primero tendrán que hacer trampas de marmotas y fabricar aceite, el cual canjearán por un perro que, finalmente, cambiarán por madera.

programme.title: Sangre apalache
programme.desc: Spencer y Eugene construyen una casa flotante, aprovechando una casa rodante abandonada, a la que tratan de hacer flotar, con un pontón hecho con varias filas de bidones herméticos.

programme.title: Expedición: Pie Grande
programme.desc: La expedición da un giro cuando Bryce se encuentra con una fotografía de una mano humana con garras.

programme.title: Guardianes del pantano
programme.desc: Dusty y su equipo descubren una especie híbrida de pitón cuando intentan evitar que las serpientes pongan sus huevos.

programme.title: Guardianes del pantano
programme.desc: Cuando una pitón que podría romper un récord se le escapa a Dusty, su obsesión por atraparla lo lleva a estar cara a cara con un reptil enorme en una de sus misiones más peligrosas.

programme.title: Oro salvaje
programme.desc: George y Scott por fin están ganando 1.5 millones de dólares en oro, pero si esperan ver su oro deben vencer las inundaciones, las fallas mecánicas y a los vecinos chinos armados.

programme.title: Fieras de la montaña
programme.desc: El equipo encuentra una pista de hace una década tallada en piedra por el difunto líder del equipo, Trapper, y llega a una revelación impactante sobre la Tierra de Nadie. Luego, siguen un rastro de sangre cuando escuchan un disparo.

programme.title: Línea de producción
programme.desc: Texas Armoring Corporation de San Antonio debe blindar un vehículo para un poderoso dignatario africano en tiempo récord. Si no cumple con los plazos, perderá un contrato multimillonario.

programme.title: Línea de producción
programme.desc: Pierce Manufacturing de Wisconsin debe entregar al Departamento de Bomberos de Santa Fe un camión nuevo en tiempo récord. Piezas defectuosas, desperfectos y cambios del cliente provocan el caos. ¿Podrá cumplir con el plazo a tiempo?

programme.title: Operación: vuelo
programme.desc: Continúa la historia de la nueva conexión a Tokio. El largo y serio viaje de Sonia Nenow. Algunos pasajeros pondrán a prueba su conocimiento de japonés. Habrá una confusión y aparecerá un nuevo personaje.

programme.title: Pesca mortal
programme.desc: Un huracán ártico azota a la tripulación con vientos fuertes y grandes olas. Mientras, los capitanes luchan contra la tormenta, Wild Bill se arriesga.

programme.title: Pesca mortal
programme.desc: Jake hace un pacto con el diablo. Sig imparte justicia en el océano. La tripulación del Cornelia Marie entiende que cuando se apuesta en una embarcación, la casa siempre gana.

programme.title: Proyecto Maersk
programme.desc: El espacio limitado de la XLE4 convierte la amenaza del fuego en un peligro real. Unos 600 operarios y el equipo de rescate hacen un simulacro para estar preparados si se concreta su peor pesadilla.

programme.title: Supercargas
programme.desc: Es difícil llevar una grúa de seis toneladas al corazón de Edimburgo, y mucho más cuando el destino es incorrecto. No es fácil girar un vehículo de dieciocho metros o hacer marcha atrás en una calle angosta.

programme.title: Expedición a lo desconocido
programme.desc: Josh Gates viaja a la Tierra Santa para investigar un misterio de proporciones bíblicas, el lugar del mítico nacimiento de Jesús. La investigación lleva a revelaciones novedosas que podrían cambiar el origen de Jesús.

programme.title: Expedición a lo desconocido
programme.sub-title: El misterio de la montaña de la muerte
programme.desc: Josh Gates se enfrenta al frío de Siberia para investigar uno de los casos más extraños y brutales de todos los tiempos: el incidente del paso Diátalov, en el que nueve senderistas soviéticos murieron sospechosamente.

programme.title: Misterios en el museo
programme.sub-title: Los huesos de Ben Franklin, la heroína del vuelo 847 y el piloto de Doctor Zhivago
programme.desc: Don Wildman investiga un horripilante conjunto de huesos, un avión secuestrado y una leyenda literaria.

programme.title: Historias animales
programme.desc: João Paulo Krajewski parte hacia una de las regiones más remotas del mundo, Komodo, en el sur de Indonesia. Allí espera encontrarse con los dragones de Komodo.

programme.title: Hoteles: secretos y leyendas
programme.sub-title: Crimen imperfecto, la sorpresa, el presidente del pueblo
programme.desc: Hoteles: secretos y leyendas presenta un infame asesinato en Chicago, la comida del hotel que decidió una elección, el hombre detrás del ataque a Pearl Harbor y la impactante campaña de 'El presidente del pueblo'.

programme.title: Misterios del castillo
programme.sub-title: Escándalo real del Baccará, soleste y Moroello, Franz Ferdinand
programme.desc: Un escándalo impactante de la monarquía se recuerda durante un recorrido por una mansión inglesa. El castillo de Bardi, en el norte de Italia, contiene una historia desgarradora de amor condenado.

programme.title: El ferrocarril de Alaska
programme.desc: Un terremoto de magnitud 4.2 amenaza con hacer descarrilar un tren de carga que avanza a toda velocidad. Steve y Cassie Brosius se apresuran a construir un refugio para proteger a su bebé.

programme.title: La peligrosa ruta del café
programme.desc: Todd Carmichael busca un nuevo descubrimiento donde nació el café, Etiopía.

programme.title: Clandestinos: el maestro destilador
programme.desc: Tim les presenta a Mark y Digger el Slivovitz de alta graduación mientras tres destiladores de primer nivel compiten para hacer el legendario licor de ciruelas de Europa del Este.

programme.title: Clandestinos: el maestro destilador
programme.desc: La jueza Pam Sutton se une a Mark, Digger y Tim mientras tres campeones de Maestro Destilador se enfrentan a elementos reales del bosque.

programme.title: Tu basura, mi fortuna: negocio redondo
programme.desc: Los personajes más excéntricos con los que se ha encontrado Drew Pritchard en el programa, lo más excéntricos y extravagantes.

programme.title: Trabajo sucio
programme.sub-title: Rehabilitación de boca y cuidador del reloj
programme.desc: Mike Rowe desciende a las profundidades de una alcantarilla envejecida y la cubre con un revestimiento de poliurea. Mike se une a un relojero y un sacerdote para establecer la hora correcta mientras restaura una torre de reloj histórica.

programme.title: Pioneros de Polonia
programme.desc: El invierno les pasa factura a los residentes de Bieszczady. La temperatura llega a 20 grados bajo cero. Eso hace que Mirek Swiszcz no pueda trabajar, su tractor principal está roto, y él hace todo lo posible para arreglarlo a tiempo.

programme.title: Alaska: peligro en el aire
programme.desc: Un grupo de patinadores construirá una pista de skateboarding para los niños de la zona. Ariel se lanza al cielo con un nuevo avión. Luego, el piloto Erik Snuggerud lucha contra la turbulencia en una entrega muy especial.

programme.title: Alaska: la última frontera
programme.desc: Mientras transportan unos terneros en barco, Otto, Charlotte y August quedan a la deriva. Atz Lee, que sigue luchando contra el TEPT, trabaja con su hijo Etienne para terminar el aislamiento de su construcción.

programme.title: 911: ¿Llamó el asesino?

programme.title: Revista People investiga: sobreviviendo al asesino

programme.title: Cuando el mal se disfraza

programme.title: Cuando el mal se disfraza
programme.desc: Cuando Chloe da a luz a su bebé a los 20 años, su familia disfruta de este momento maravilloso en su vida, aunque la madre no parece estar encantada con la situación, pronto alguien traiciona su confianza.

programme.title: Revista People investiga

programme.title: Justicia por mano propia
programme.desc: La desaparición de Michaela MacVilla, de 21 años, desencadena una movilización masiva, encabezada por investigadores de la policía. Pero requerirá que resuelvan un misterio complejo, profundizando en el mundo del análisis forense digital.

programme.title: Justicia por mano propia

programme.title: Confesiones de un asesino con James Holland
programme.desc: Después de que el ranger James Holland recibe una llamada de la Policía Estatal de Pensilvania, se encuentra cara a cara con un testigo que podría ser la clave para resolver uno de los casos fríos más antiguos en la historia del estado.

programme.title: Terror en casa
programme.desc: Kristi y Jim Newman, una pareja de recién casados, ponen a prueba sus creencias cristianas cuando se enfrentan a tres hombres enmascarados en su casa. Pero los intrusos no solo quieren robarles.

programme.title: Terror en casa

programme.desc: Albert Lin explora Perú en busca de la ciudad perdida de los Guerreros de las Nubes.

programme.title: Mayday: Catástrofes aéreas : Terror sobre Michigan
programme.desc: Después de que los pasajeros de un Boeing 727 estuvieran al borde de la muerte sobre Michigan, los investigadores arriesgan sus propias vidas para determinar por qué el vuelo 841 de TWA cayó del cielo.

programme.title: África: El hogar de la vida salvaje : Las llanuras
programme.desc: Las mayores congregaciones de vida silvestre del planeta luchan contra las implicaciones del cambio constante.

programme.title: África: El hogar de la vida salvaje : Condiciones extremas
programme.desc: África es una tierra implacable, donde los extremos son la norma. Es el continente más caluroso del planeta, pero en algunas regiones el termómetro puede marcar temperaturas bajo cero.

programme.title: Salvajemente famosos : Rob Riggle en Islandia

programme.desc: Armado únicamente con herramientas básicas y los conocimientos ancestrales de los masái, Hazen tendrá que ascender más de dos mil metros hasta la cumbre de un volcán activo, para hacer una ofrenda en nombre de su tribu.

programme.title: Mayday: Catástrofes aéreas : Descenso imposible
programme.desc: Un avión de carga cae en picada a la tierra en el Ártico sueco. A medida que los investigadores analizan la evidencia, surge una imagen aterradora de caos y confusión.

programme.title: Secreto en los océanos : Submarinos nazis
programme.desc: Una mirada a las naves submarinas alemanas, las primeras armas invisibles del mundo.

programme.title: Tesoros perdidos de Egipto : Acertijos de la Esfinge
programme.desc: Los arqueólogos buscan pistas para desentrañar los misterios de la Gran Esfinge.

programme.title: Alerta Aeropuerto: Roma : Santos y pecadores
programme.desc: La policía antidrogas intenta descubrir qué esconde un pasajero en sus zapatos. Las vacaciones de tres supuestos amigos se ven amenazadas. Los agentes antidrogas investigan a una pasajera que no hace más que rezar.
